payload.title: Every list uses one rule: rolling seven-day buckets, then quality, then recency
payload.description:
What: one core ordering function used by Articles, Posts, Videos, Findings and concept pages. Newest rolling seven-day bucket first; within a bucket higher quality first; equal quality in the same bucket, most recent first. Extends PPY-3d26a0 (which adds the bucket option to the references include) to all lists. A rating never moves an item to another bucket.
Why: today lists disagree (newest update vs best item), so the same reader sees two orders on one page.
Acceptance:
Scenario: Newer bucket beats a better older item
  Given a Reference rated 5 stars 9 days ago and one rated 3 stars 2 days ago
  When the list is built
  Then the 3-star item comes first
Scenario: Equal quality in one bucket puts the most recent first
  Given two items with equal quality in the same bucket
  When the list is built
  Then the more recent item comes first
